## Training Course

🗓️ 2-3 September 2026 📍 Trento, Italy

- Advanced training on the diagnosis and mitigation of slope instability
- More information is available [here](/files/trento.pdf) or contact Giuseppe Pedone (giuseppe.pedone@unitn.it)

## Summer PhD School 2027

- Currently being organized by the University of Perugia and the University of Florence.
- This school is specifically designed to train PhD candidates and early-career researchers in state-of-the-art experimental techniques, monitoring strategies, and numerical modelling for SVA interaction.
